ABOUT THE SUIT

We turn ideas into things that work.

Pentacles is a five-member subgroup of the Polaris programming team. We build carefully and finish what we start, from the first sketch to something people can actually use.

We split the work, review each other's code, and ship together — data and machine learning, full-stack and platform, applications and interface, all under one suit.
